headings.description: Clean, geometric sans-serif for sharp, modern headings. Used for H1-H4 and prominent data points.

body.description: Highly legible sans-serif for rigorous numerical alignment in tables and forms.

rules: H1 (Hero): text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight text-primary font-semibold
H2 (Section): text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight text-primary font-medium
H3 (Card Title): text-sm sm:text-base uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-secondary font-medium
Data Highlights: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tighter
Use #F7F7F8 for the main app background to provide subtle contrast against white cards.
Use #0A0A0A (Anthracite/Obsidian) for primary text and main CTA buttons for a premium feel.
Use #FF5A5F (Coral) strictly for Delivery Target (Teslim Hedefi) highlights, progress bar fill, and the specific delivery month row in the table.
Never use pure black or pure gray; always tint slightly.

surfaces_and_shadows.inputs: bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-900 focus:border-zinc-900 transition-all
surfaces_and_shadows.buttons_primary: bg-zinc-900 text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors shadow-md
surfaces_and_shadows.buttons_secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors

layout_and_grids.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-8
layout_and_grids.table_section: mt-12 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200/60 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
layout_and_grids.spacing_rules: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside summary cards. Use gap-6 between form elements.

PlanBilgileriForm.description: Left column form. Needs currency masks (e.g., 2.000.000 TL). Use Shadcn UI Select, Input, and Slider. Labels must be left-aligned, small, uppercase tracking-wide.

PlanOzetiCards.description: Bento grid for live metrics. The 'Teslim Hedefi' card must be larger (col-span-full sm:col-span-2) with a prominent progress bar.

TeslimProgressBar.description: A thick (h-3) progress bar. Background zinc-100, fill Coral (#FF5A5F). Add a marker at the 45% threshold line.

OdemePlaniTable.description: Detailed datatable using Shadcn Table. Columns: Dönem, Taksit Tarihi, Aylık Ödeme, Toplam Ödeme, Kalan Borç, Ödeme Türü. The row where 'Kalan Borç' hits the delivery threshold must have `bg-coral-50` and coral text.

ScenarioComparison.description: A side-by-side comparison view for up to 4 plans. Use Shadcn Sheet or a dedicated route with a 4-column CSS grid.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons must have subtle scale (-translate-y-[1px]) and shadow increase on hover.
interactions_and_motion.live_calculation: Use Framer Motion `<AnimatePresence>` or a number ticker to animate numbers in the summary cards when form values change.
interactions_and_motion.table_rows: Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) for table rows when a new plan is generated.

media_and_icons.icon_usage: Use icons sparingly. Use in summary card headers (16px, text-zinc-400) and primary actions.

hero_background.description: Use as a very subtle, low-opacity (5%) background image or texture in the top header area to add a premium architectural feel.

localization.currency_format: Intl.NumberFormat('tr-TR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }). All outputs must show as 'X.XXX.XXX ₺' or 'TL'.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on coral backgrounds has sufficient contrast (use dark text if background is light coral).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-xl) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Ensure the Turkish formatting for currency (₺/TL) and dates is strictly adhered to.
The Delivery row in the table MUST be visually distinct (Coral/Red tint).
